facts.text: Miguel, wipe your feet, eat your tamales and put that guitar away. No music in this house. I mean it.
facts.why: Printed as Abuelita's own words but she never says it. Her real line after she smashes Miguel's guitar is 'There. No guitar. No music. Aw, come. You'll feel better after you eat with your family.'
facts.fix: Aw, come. You'll feel better after you eat with your family.

fix_note.text: Aw, come. You'll feel better after you eat with your family.

vibe.verdict: A warm invite with real Mexican dishes and the right family, but the ban on music is the whole menu's only joke and the Land of the Dead is barely there.
